config.legacy_admission: original IL world/context envelope authenticates reconstruction only; new actual caps are stricter and independently enforced
config.scientific_scope: Supervised recorded-action continuation ranking on same four TRAIN worlds; no negative preparation-success evidence, held-out improvement, Q optimality, clinical or physical claim
config.selection: same full certified inventory; rank actual-immediate-positive candidates by positive Q, original inventory order ties, otherwise exact GREEDY fallback; STOP iff no actual-positive candidate
config.target: Q_i=r_i+max(0,Q_(i+1)); STOP=0; current negative action cost preserved
config.training: frozen IL64 full policy, separate actor-MLP clone,64 full-batch Adam updates lr.001 clip5; equal subject/trace/state mass; only logged action rows supervised

cost_scope: All source reconstruction, every preview/inventory, historical replay,497 feature forwards,64 head updates, all four endpoint plans and fresh replay. Inclusive phases overlap; do not sum them.

native_budget.excluded_costs: Shared original preparation, ingress screening, selected initial inventory and independent audit must be reported separately.

native_preview_profile.scope: process cumulative native preview calls, including constructor/fresh/next-inventory work
native_preview_profile.unmeasured: internal preview subphases, bytes copied/hashed, engine initialization and integrity time require separate profiling

native_budget.request_interpretation: Zero-preview returns may be cached, empty or STOP-only; cache hits are not instrumented.
native_budget.wall_limit: Cooperative checks; in-flight native/C work cannot be forcibly stopped here. External process supervision is required.
